scope: All 24 owned f85r2 loci; ZL primary, IT/RF separate.
no_semantic_confirmation: All words are invented C0 bindings, including source-topic words. Counts establish coverage only.
authoring_order: N, W, E, S, outer .1/.24; final occurrence table restored to physical source order.

clauses.candidate_formula: forall e in E forall p in P COMPONENT(e,p)
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Every one of the four elements is a component of every person.

clauses.candidate_formula: FOURFOLD(HumanNature) & ANALOGOUS_TO(HumanNature,PARTITION(Year,4)); HumanNature and Year retain different sorts
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Human nature is fourfold, analogously to the year’s four divisions.
Predominance grounds inclination and constitution.
unresolved: Schema-level relation between attributes; no individual patient is supplied. Pointwise human-owner interpretation needs acceptance of G11.

clauses.candidate_formula: PROPOSED_DISTRIBUTION: forall e in E exists p in P PREDOMINATES(e,p); differing strict dominant elements may have different owners; not EXCLUSIVE_COMPONENT(e,p)
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Different elements predominate in different persons.
unresolved: The each-element/existing-person distribution is an added scope choice, not licensed by the fixed ALL frames. Literal word DIFFERENT alone does not establish it.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: The regimen of persons is relative to constitutional inclination.
unresolved: Nominal datum + criterion frame G12, and image-domain application G08, are added interpretations; relevance does not assert that any particular treatment succeeds.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: Constitution names arise from the predominant elemental contribution.
unresolved: Attribute/domain relation is schematic; no individual owner or exact names are supplied.

clauses.syntax: [[ALL PERSONS] BENEFITED_BY [ALL TREATMENTS] NOT] RELATIVE_TO CONSTITUTIONS
clauses.candidate_formula: P0 = NOT(forall p in P forall t in T BENEFIT(p,t)); PROPOSED_TAIL = P0 & RELEVANT_CRITERION(C,P0)
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Not every treatment benefits every person; constitution is a relevant criterion.
unresolved: First six groups retain the exact raw proposition. qokal shedy is not discarded. Whether a criterion-domain can modify that completed proposition as G12 proposes remains an explicit source/type audit obligation.

clauses.candidate_formula: WEAK_MODAL_CANDIDATE: POSSIBLE(COUNTER_TO(VoluntaryConduct,ConstitutionDomain)); no forall-person ability or achieved change follows
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Voluntary conduct may run contrary to constitution.
unresolved: The source’s fine agency/scope syntax is uncertain. This remains a weak possibility schema between concepts; no individual actor is identified or inserted.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: Names and constitutions follow predominance.
unresolved: Added schema-level relation; a pointwise naming rule is not independently bound.

clauses.syntax: [ALL PERSONS] NEVERTHELESS [IS MIXED AND IS INCLINED]
clauses.candidate_formula: forall p in P (MIXED(p) & INCLINED(p)); NEVERTHELESS contrasts common membership with the preceding predominance schema
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Every person nevertheless is mixed and has an inclination.

clauses.candidate_formula: exists e in E exists p,q in P SHARE(e,p) != SHARE(e,q)
clauses.hypothetical_reading: The shares of the elements vary among persons.
Air supplies breath.
Cold is opposed to heat.
Within living bodies, constitution depends on predominance.
unresolved: The source speaks of living things’ complex/nature and human complexions. Extending the same ConstitutionAttribute schema to the whole LivingBody domain needs source review; no species or organ is invented.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: Dryness is opposed to moisture.
Conflict can cause harm.
Persons’ composition is of the elements.
unresolved: This is a proposed domain-level composition frame, not a replacement of aiin by an individual. Its relationship to pointwise composition is not derived from the fixed seed grammar. N2 already independently states the candidate all-element/all-person clause.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: Conflict can cause harm and death.
Every constitution inclines toward its predominant element.
unresolved: An explicit owner quantifier is present, but the attribute PredominantElement(c) is a new derived term; the source principally describes persons bearing that inclination.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: Constitutions classify persons in four ways.
Human mixture derives from the contribution of every element.
Cold contending with heat can cause harm.
unresolved: G14 reifies the opposition as a conflict event. It must not equate mere co-presence of opposite qualities with an actual harmful conflict.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: Constitution guides treatment.
unresolved: GUIDES is a criterion relation, not a claim that constitution acts as an agent or that every treatment benefits every person.

clauses.hypothetical_reading: All living bodies are composite and elemental.
Fire contributes warmth.
Water supplies blood and moisture.
Earth supplies flesh, and earth supplies bone.

clauses.syntax: AND [STUDY OF PERSONS] [EXPLAINS CONSTITUTION] [IS NECESSARY FOR [[PERSONS REGIMEN] FROM [INCLINATION AND CONSTITUTION]]]
clauses.hypothetical_reading: Study of persons explains constitution and is necessary for their regimen based on inclination and constitution.
unresolved: Two predicates share one overt study-subject by G15. Genitives, image-domain ownership and purpose attachment are newly proposed. Necessary-for-regimen is a goal condition, not an unconditional order that every person studies.

clauses.syntax: REGIMEN SHOULD_CONSIDER [PREDOMINANT [ELEMENTS CONTRIBUTION]] [COMMON MEMBERSHIP] AND [[ALL PERSONS] INCLINATION AND NATURE]
clauses.hypothetical_reading: For every person, regimen should consider the predominant elemental contribution, common membership, inclination and nature.
unresolved: The postposed ALL-person owner scope G10 spans the listed attributes in this one clause. This exact attachment is not independently bound. Treating common membership as a regimen criterion is a source-inference requiring review, not a quoted source instruction.
